synthetic_banner: Synthetic demo data: generated sites and readings, not real measurements.
footer_synthetic: All sites, readings and users in this demo are synthetic (seeded generator). No real company or sensor data.
pdf_footer_synthetic: SYNTHETIC DATA: generated for a portfolio demo, not real measurements
synthetic_csv_note: SYNTHETIC DATA: generated demo readings (not real measurements)
login_intro: Temperature and humidity across all sites.
login_throttled: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
reason_long_out_of_range: out of range over 1% of the time
unreliable_note: Readings from a stuck sensor (the same temperature and humidity for hours) are not real measurements: the true value is unknown. They are kept and marked, but left out of averages, min/max and out-of-range counts.
table_units_note: Temperatures in °C, humidity in %, out of range in hours. Averages and min/max use valid readings only.
chart_site_compare: Average temperature and hours out of range by site
chart_temp_by_site: Temperature by site: min, average, max (°C)
chart_quality_by_site: Completeness and hours out of range by site
compare_note: All charts use valid readings only; stuck-sensor readings are excluded.
reports_intro: One PDF per site per month and an all-sites summary. Reports are rebuilt after each upload; a stale report is rebuilt when you download it.
reports_queued: Rebuilding this month's reports in the background. Refresh in a minute.
rebuild_month: Rebuild all reports for this month
uploads_intro: Choose one or more monthly Excel files (.xlsx) or a .zip of them, up to {mb} MB each. The site and month come from the file name (e.g. RUH-01_2026-08.xlsx) or the Info sheet. Uploading the same file twice changes nothing.
upload_too_large: A file is larger than {mb} MB.
reports_after_upload: The PDF reports for these months are being rebuilt in the background.
upload_msg_zip_too_many_files: zip has {count} files; the limit is {limit}
upload_msg_zip_too_large: zip is too large when uncompressed
upload_msg_zip_member_too_large: file inside the zip is too large or suspiciously compressed
upload_msg_zip_nested: zip inside a zip is not supported
upload_msg_not_xlsx: only .xlsx workbooks are accepted (or a .zip of them)
upload_msg_xlsx_invalid: not a valid .xlsx file (it is not an Office Open XML workbook)
upload_msg_xlsx_no_workbook: not a valid .xlsx file (no workbook inside)
upload_msg_xlsx_macro: macro-enabled workbook; save it as a plain .xlsx
upload_msg_xlsx_too_large: workbook is too large when uncompressed
upload_msg_no_header: no sheet has a Date / Time / Temperature / Humidity header in its first 10 rows
upload_msg_site_month_conflict: filename says {file_site} {file_month} but the cover sheet says {cover_site} {cover_month}; fix one of them and upload again
upload_msg_site_month_unknown: cannot tell the site and month: name the file like RUH-01_2026-05.xlsx or add an Info sheet with 'Site code' and 'Month'
upload_msg_wrong_month: most rows are not in {month}; check the site/month in the filename
upload_msg_internal_error: processing failed ({error}); nothing from this file was saved

upload_msg_header_row.one: header found on row {row}; {n} row above it ignored
upload_msg_header_row.other: header found on row {row}; {n} rows above it ignored

upload_msg_cover_sheet: site and month taken from the Info cover sheet
upload_msg_dates_dmy: dates are written as DD/MM/YYYY text; read day-first
upload_msg_dates_mdy: dates are written as MM/DD/YYYY text; read month-first
upload_msg_dates_assumed_dmy: dates are written as a/b/YYYY and every day is 12 or less; assumed day-first (DD/MM/YYYY)
upload_msg_dates_mixed: dates mix day-first and month-first; rows that don't fit day-first are rejected
upload_msg_dates_serial: dates are stored as plain Excel serial numbers; converted
upload_msg_duplicate_file: identical file already loaded (upload #{upload_id}); nothing changed
thresholds_intro: Readings outside these limits count as out of range. Changes apply at once to the dashboard; existing PDFs are marked stale. Every change is logged.
pdf_legend_temp: Line: daily average. Shaded: daily min to max. Dashed red: limits. Valid readings only; x-axis is the day of the month.
pdf_legend_hum: Daily average humidity. Dashed red: limits. Valid readings only.
pdf_legend_profile: Solid: temperature (°C, left axis). Dashed: humidity (%, right axis). Valid readings only.
pdf_legend_sites: Bars: average temperature (°C, left axis), coloured by status. Dots: hours out of range (right axis).
pdf_files_loaded: Files loaded for this month: {n}. Files with rejected rows:
pdf_units_note: Temperatures in °C, humidity in %, out of range in hours. Sorted by status.
pdf_definitions: Completeness = readings received / expected (hourly). Unreliable = readings in a stuck-sensor period; excluded from averages, min/max and out-of-range counts. Out of range = a valid reading outside the site's limits; an event is a run of consecutive out-of-range hours. Same definitions and numbers as the dashboard.
